Introducing support for Renters Insurance

Axle has expanded its insurance data platform to include renters insurance. This update enables partners to instantly verify renters policies in real time — improving compliance, reducing manual work, and enhancing the tenant onboarding experience.

Feature Spotlight: August 2025

This month we're excited to announce the launch of Axle support for a new policy type - flood insurance, and we’re highlighting major improvements to the Axle Dashboard experience for our monitoring customers.

Introducing Flood Insurance

Axle now offers wide-release support for Flood Insurance policies, enabling partners to securely verify coverage in seconds, reduce manual processes, and integrate seamlessly into existing workflows.

We’re building the AI Native
Clearinghouse for Insurance

Our vision
Open access to insurance

Before Axle, fleet managers, asset lenders, employers, and other entities relied on outdated systems, documents, and lengthy phone calls to verify personal insurance information or assumed the multi-billion dollar risk of uninsured or underinsured assets.

Why, because it was impossible to build a clearinghouse because insurance relies on fragmented systems and documents.

Until now. Axle’s worker agents navigate systems and interpret unstructured data at scale, connecting siloed insurance data to the economy.

With Axle, insurance data becomes instantly accessible to all, eliminating risk and allowing our partners to make critical decisions in seconds instead of days or hours.

Join us
We care deeply about the quality of our work

We are a growing organization based in New York and Atlanta, but what unites us is building at the frontier, relentless focus on the customer, and our passion for championing open access to financial data.
